dashboardItems.text: Note: bar shows the quarter of each patient's *follow-up visit*

*DIABETES TREATMENT OUTCOMES* 
Overview of outcomes of diabetes health service delivery. The data gives an overview of how well people are managed and if they are reaching key treatment targets, such as blood sugar (BS) control rates.

*DIABETES ENROLMENT* 
Overview of the number of people with diabetes under care in the facility. This includes rates of newly registered patients and patients lost to follow up.

*DIABETES TREATMENT AND COMPLICATIONS MANAGEMENT* 
Overview of diabetes health service delivery and complication management at facility level. Provides insights into how complication assessments and follow up (referrals) comply with guidelines.

Definitions

This section contains definitions of all indicators and building blocks used in this dashboard.

*HYPERTENSION TREATMENT OUTCOMES* 
Overview of outcomes of hypertension health service delivery. The data shows how well people are managed and if they are reaching key treatment targets, such as blood pressure (BP) control rates

*HYPERTENSION ENROLMENT*
Overview of the number of people with hypertension under care in the facility. This includes rates of newly registered patients and patients lost to follow up.

*HYPERTENSION TREATMENT AND COMPLICATIONS MANAGEMENT*
Overview of hypertension health service delivery and complication management at facility level. Provides insights into how complication assessments and follow up (referrals) comply with guidelines.
*AFTER IMPORT, INSERT HEALTH FACILITY PROFILE INDICATORS FOR NCDS HERE*

*Important note:* Estimated prevalence depends on *survey data source*. This will very likely overestimate burden of disease, as cases identified by community survey are not confirmed at a health facility. Interpret cascade diagrams with caution.
